aomMurmillo.description: Heavy infantry of Atlantis, with a fish-crested helmet, a short sword and a square shield.

aomMurmilloChampion.description: A champion who fought his way out of the arena, a sword in each hand.

aomMurmilloGuard.description: A guard of the royal city in orichalcum armor, never without his shield.

aomMurmilloHero.description: A gladiator turned hero by the favor of the gods.

aomArcus.description: An Atlantean archer with a recurve bow.

aomArcusFar.description: A longbowman in a winged helmet whose arrows carry far.

aomArcusVolley.description: An archer who looses several arrows in one breath.

aomArcusHero.description: An archer turned hero by the favor of the gods.

aomAutomaton.description: A warrior cast in bronze. Fallen automatons are repaired by their companions.

aomAutomatonKronos.description: An automaton forged of black iron.

aomAutomatonGaia.description: A bronze automaton covered in verdigris.

aomCaladria.description: A priestess riding a sacred bird, able to heal her companions.

aomCaladriaUranus.description: A lance-bearing guard riding a white-plumed sacred bird.

aomCaladriaGaia.description: A seer riding a green-plumed sacred bird.

aomNereid.description: A sea nymph riding a shark.

aomNereidKronos.description: A sea nymph who charges the enemy line on a tiger shark.

aomNereidUranus.description: A sea nymph who hurls tridents from the back of her shark.

aomCentimanus.description: A hundred-handed giant, once imprisoned in Tartarus.

aomCentimanusKronos.description: A hundred-handed giant that has broken its chains.

aomCentimanusUranus.description: A hundred-handed giant studded with starlight.

aomTitan.description: A titan with molten lava flowing over its body.

aomTitanKronos.description: A titan wielding a giant sickle, a creation of the Master of Time.

aomTitanGaia.description: A titan covered in moss and rock, a creation of Mother Earth.

aomPromethean.description: A figure Prometheus shaped from clay. Shattered, it can be shaped again.

aomStymphalian.description: A monstrous bird of Lake Stymphalia with feathers of bronze.

aomTartarian.description: A fiend that crawled out of the Tartarian Gate.

aomArgus.description: A monster covered in eyes that spits corrosive acid.

aomPrometheanOffspring.description: A small figure made from leftover clay.

aomServant.description: A servant of the sea god, able to heal its companions.

aomSatyr.description: A goat-man of the wooded hills, skilled with the javelin.

aomDryad.description: A tree nymph who guards the golden apple tree.

aomLampades.description: An attendant of Hekate, an underworld nymph carrying a torch.

aomManOWar.description: A jellyfish floating in mid-air, its tentacles crackling with lightning.

aomCarnivora.description: A man-eating plant rooted in the ground.

aomLampadesStar.description: An underworld nymph whose torch burns with starlight.

aomOracle.description: An oracle priest of Atlantis who foresees ill omens.

aomKatapeltes.description: Infantry with long hammers, trained to bring down cavalry and giant beasts.

aomDestroyer.description: A heavily armored siege soldier who does not fear arrows.

aomFanatic.description: A zealot with a blade in each hand, striking twice in one attack.

aomTurma.description: Light cavalry throwing javelins from horseback.

aomContarius.description: Heavy cavalry charging with a long lance.

aomCheiroballista.description: The war machine of Atlantis, a bolt thrower mounted on a cart. Its damage grows with the hero's Attack.

aomFireSiphon.description: A siege wagon that spews fire.

aomBehemoth.description: A giant beast clad in iron that no city wall can stop.

aomArcusTurret.description: A recurve archer posted in the arrow towers of the Atlantean walls.

aomCommander.description: The Chief Oracle of Atlantis, the commander who marches with the hero. Standing still to read the heavens, he points out targets for all the army's shooters; with sacrifice and prayer he wins the favor of the gods for the hero.
